pollIntervalSeconds.description: The number of seconds to wait between checks

initialWaitSeconds.description: The number of seconds to wait before the first check

maxWaitSeconds.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait

terminateIfNotRunning.description: If `true`, then if the engine is not running after #maxWaitSeconds, {@link Engine#terminate} will be called.

title: A spec for controlling how {@link GenaiCore.EngineUtil#waitForEngineRunning} should behave
name: GenaiCore.EngineUtil.WaitSpec
